```{r, results='asis'}
rank_change_filtered <- tables$rank_change

if (!is.null(rank_change_filtered) && "final_score" %in% names(rank_change_filtered)) {
  rank_change_filtered <- rank_change_filtered %>%
    filter(!is.na(final_score), final_score > 0)
}

show_rank_changes <- mode != "Mode1" &&
  !is.null(rank_change_filtered) &&
  nrow(rank_change_filtered) > 0

if (show_rank_changes) {
  cat("# Rank changes\n\n## Input Top20 and final Top20\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (show_rank_changes) {
  # Recompute the union from the filtered complete rank-change table.
  union_tbl <- rank_change_filtered %>%
    filter(input_rank <= 20 | final_rank <= 20) %>%
    mutate(
      in_input_top20 = input_rank <= 20,
      in_final_top20 = final_rank <= 20
    )

  union_show <- union_tbl %>%
    select(any_of(c(
      "input_region",
      "input_score",
      "input_rank",
      "final_score",
      "final_rank",
      "rank_change",
      "in_input_top20",
      "in_final_top20"
    ))) %>%
    arrange(final_rank) %>%
    fmt_df() %>%
    pretty_names()

  dt_tbl(
    union_show,
    caption = "Union of input-score Top20 and final-score Top20",
    page_length = 25,
    max_rows = 40
  )
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
if (show_rank_changes) {
  make_rank_change_plot <- function(df, order_col, plot_title) {
    df <- df %>%
      arrange(.data[[order_col]], input_region) %>%
      mutate(
        row_id = rev(seq_len(n())),
        display_gene = if_else(
          is.na(display_gene) | trimws(as.character(display_gene)) == "",
          "",
          compact_semicolon_text(display_gene, max_items = 3)
        )
      )

    max_rank <- max(c(df$input_rank, df$final_rank), na.rm = TRUE)
    left_pad <- max(2, ceiling(max_rank * 0.06))
    right_pad <- max(3, ceiling(max_rank * 0.12))
    gene_x <- 1 - right_pad * 0.55

    p <- ggplot(df) +
      geom_segment(aes(
        y = row_id,
        yend = row_id,
        x = input_rank,
        xend = final_rank
      )) +
      geom_point(aes(x = input_rank, y = row_id), size = 2) +
      geom_point(aes(x = final_rank, y = row_id), size = 2, shape = 17) +
      geom_text(
        aes(x = gene_x, y = row_id, label = display_gene),
        hjust = 0,
        size = 4.1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = df$row_id,
        labels = df$input_region,
        expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))
      ) +
      scale_x_reverse(
        limits = c(max_rank + left_pad, 1 - right_pad),
        breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = gene_x,
        y = max(df$row_id) + 0.8,
        label = "Gene",
        hjust = 0,
        fontface = "bold",
        size = 4.2
      ) +
      labs(
        title = plot_title,
        subtitle = "Circle: input-score rank; triangle: final RWR rank",
        x = "Rank, reversed so rank 1 is farther right",
        y = NULL
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.margin = margin(8, 95, 8, 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold")
      )
    p
  }

  input_top20 <- rank_change_filtered %>%
    filter(input_rank <= 20) %>%
    arrange(input_rank, final_rank)

  final_top20 <- rank_change_filtered %>%
    filter(final_rank <= 20) %>%
    arrange(final_rank, input_rank)

  p_input <- make_rank_change_plot(
    input_top20,
    order_col = "input_rank",
    plot_title = "Input-score Top20"
  )
  p_final <- make_rank_change_plot(
    final_top20,
    order_col = "final_rank",
    plot_title = "Final-score Top20"
  )

  fig_dir <- file.path(report_dir, "figures")
  dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  input_png <- file.path(fig_dir, "rank_change_input_top20.png")
  final_png <- file.path(fig_dir, "rank_change_final_top20.png")
  ggsave(input_png, p_input, width = 8.4, height = 7.2, dpi = 180, bg = "white")
  ggsave(final_png, p_final, width = 8.4, height = 7.2, dpi = 180, bg = "white")

  # Embed the PNG files directly from the actual ranking-output path:
  # <ranking output>/report/figures/.  Using data URIs avoids Pandoc
  # resolving the files relative to the Rmd working directory.
  input_src <- knitr::image_uri(normalizePath(input_png, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
  final_src <- knitr::image_uri(normalizePath(final_png, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))

  htmltools::div(
    style = "display:flex; gap:18px; align-items:flex-start; width:100%;",
    htmltools::div(
      style = "flex:1; min-width:0;",
      htmltools::tags$img(src = input_src, style = "width:100%; height:auto;")
    ),
    htmltools::div(
      style = "flex:1; min-width:0;",
      htmltools::tags$img(src = final_src, style = "width:100%; height:auto;")
    )
  )
}
```
